bootstrapIdentity.purpose: one-time creation of deployment/state scopes and constrained delegation
bootstrapIdentity.rule: Use a human/admin bootstrap identity only long enough to create the dedicated DE.PULSE development resource/state scopes and assign the federated deployment identity its bounded roles; remove unnecessary bootstrap elevation afterward.

deploymentIdentity.purpose: repeatable Terraform plan/apply/drift and AKS live verification
requiredCapabilities: manage resources inside the dedicated DE.PULSE development environment scope
read/write Terraform state blobs in the dedicated state container
create only the bounded Network Contributor assignment required by the AKS user-assigned control-plane identity
invoke/read AKS run-command results for private-cluster verification

recommendedRoleModel.reason: manage AKS/VNet/identity resources without general Azure RBAC assignment authority

recommendedRoleModel.condition: constrain assignment capability to the AKS managed identity and the Network Contributor role when Azure ABAC conditions are available
recommendedRoleModel.reason: Terraform must bind the AKS control-plane identity to its BYO VNet without granting broad Owner authority
